text: Being here, I feel an odd mix of anticipation and curiosity. The first scene, an empty meeting room with its technological trappings, makes me ponder the silence before collaboration—the quiet charged with potential. In the second scene, surrounded by exhibits and the bold promise of research and development, I sense the relentless momentum of human inquiry. Both spaces push me to reflect on the boundaries between solitude and collective creativity, on how places are shaped by the ideas and energies that pass through them. Am I an observer or a contributor to this unfolding momentum?
